files.input.json: Exact modulus, odd selector width, nonzero weights, target and source provenance
files.A0.poly,A1.poly,A2.poly: P and its first two normal-form products by X=c+sum(y)
files.F0.poly,F1.poly,F2.poly: Coefficient polynomials of 1,U,U^2 in the full remainder F
files.certificate.json: Exact degrees, term counts, both projected U-polynomials, formula comparison, artifact hashes and scope
files.manifest.json: Every payload path and SHA256; manifest excludes itself

poly_encoding.terms: strictly increasing mask:u64le, nonzero coefficient:u128le; masks below 2^ell, coefficients below p
poly_encoding.zero_polynomial: zero terms, stored degree0; mathematical degree is null
poly_encoding.distinction: Centered quotient codec magic differs from historical idempotent polynomial codec

claim_scope: Exact arithmetic certificate; reviewed filtered-space argument is a separate dependency. No exact LFD or regularity value is encoded.
preservation: Fresh directories only; retain failures and every generated polynomial. No replacement of existing fixed-base or producer records.
